sentences.en: The actor's death made big headlines in all the papers.
sentences.zh: 这位演员的死讯登上了所有报纸的大字标题。

sentences.en: I was furious when I saw a newspaper headline today.
sentences.zh: 看到今天的报纸头条我非常生气。

sentences.en: "Missiles accused to be extradited" is a headline of today's BBC.
sentences.zh: ‘导弹嫌疑人将被引渡’是今天BBC的头条新闻。
